scope: First of two small protocol prerequisites: real bounded encode/decode, request binding and structural ACK validation. No Current provider, transport, authority, recovery, pool binding or production caller is added.

diff.formatting: Manual source layout only; original just fmt is still required in the sole native lane.

source_proofs.use: All 15 wire declarations and field ordering retained. Corrected docs make authentication/Current separate. Unused private writer matches method deferred until the successor validator actually calls it.
Original exact-byte request digest contract, 32768-byte limit, request/schema/status binding and token/head epoch/counter consistency. No donor transport/coordinator moved.
Reuse the existing Refused/Unavailable checkpoint error, while leaving its real protected acknowledgement trait and caller unmodified.

Sha256Digest derives transparent Deserialize; that path does not call parse. Codec explicitly invokes parse for all digest-valued request/ACK fields, including optional proposal and retained request, without recomputing any opaque server token.
Actual canonical UUID type used by the synthetic wire fixture.

behavior: Encode checks schema=1, exact operation, 32 ASCII-hex request ID with nonzero epoch/sequence, supported command/expected/proposal shape, digest syntax and actual serialized byte length.

The owner codec supports ReadHead and the existing BeginWrites/PreparePublication/CommitPublication shape. FencePublisher remains a wire variant for the protected service lifecycle; this codec refuses to construct that operation.

Decode rejects empty/oversized frames before JSON decoding, unknown/duplicate fields through the existing explicit serde structs, mismatched request/schema, malformed ACK reason/missing head or token, mismatched token/head epoch/counter, malformed exact-cut identity/profile and malformed digest text.
Refused remains Refused; Unknown and malformed ACK remain Unavailable. A valid opaque 64-hex token is returned unchanged; no token or authority is derived from local JSON or SQLite.
Full predecessor/successor comparison is intentionally not supplied by decode_ack. R2e2b adds that next; no recovery/binder/Current caller may treat this wire result alone as qualification.

tests.evidence: Synthetic real serialized request/response byte frames only, not a live Root or filesystem qualification.
controls: Round-trip the complete typed receipt with a server-supplied opaque token. Exactly 32768 response bytes (valid trailing whitespace) decode; one extra byte, empty, invalid UTF-8 and trailing garbage reject.

Mutate raw JSON schema/request-id/reason/missing head or token/counters/epochs/cut identity/profile/digest syntax; add unknown outer and nested fields; insert a duplicate schema field. Check exact error classifications including Refused and Unknown.

Malformed byte-length/non-ASCII/non-hex/zero request IDs fail without indexing unvalidated UTF-8. Bad operation/schema and unsupported command shapes fail. A complete valid PreparePublication request encodes before increasing only its lease_id past the actual byte cap.
tests.no_baseline_claim: This is a new API; absence of the module in cabc is not a runtime negative control. Malformed frames are executable input negatives once the real code compiles.

preservation.production_calls: No Agentd main, production_composition, production_writer_host, generic host attachment, original_sender or bootstrap ACK touched.
preservation.r2e1: The exact-duplicate rollback followed by its independent acknowledgement remains unchanged. from_read_only_pool remains protected by the actual cold-image readonly mechanism, not a newly claimed commit hook.

dependencies.compile: Uses only current Memory exports and already-declared serde, serde_json, sha2/contracts/error types. No compile dependency on proposed R1/R2a/R2c/R2d/R2e1.
dependencies.integration: A live Current consumer still requires the real transport, full CAS validator, owner serialization, cancellation fence, exact recovery, exclusive ownership, coordinated writer/observer/barrier and preserved original sender.
dependencies.files: No Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, MODULE.bazel.lock or BUILD change. No include_str/include_bytes/new compile_data or binary.
dependencies.lock_gate: No new dependency edge to regenerate in this cohort; normal frozen lock checks remain applicable when the whole candidate is built.

required_commands.receipts: Sole native executor must retain exact source tree/file hashes, host/toolchain, complete actual roster, fresh JUnit, raw output and terminal exit. No test rerun after fix/fmt; inspect and retain resulting source deltas.

not_done: No source-tree, target, branch, PR or ref mutation.
No actual Root peer/credential handling, grant/signature creation, Current admission or external action.
No statement that read-only pool is commit-hook protected.
